item.tib: skyabs 'gro bsnyen gnas gso sbyong dge bsnyen sems sdom ngag sdom rnams kyi cho ga bsdus pa nyer mkho rnams gsal
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni gtso cher khyim pa rnams kyi nyams su blangs bde ba'i ched du dad ldan du mas nan bskul gyi ngor 'dul ba'i las chog dang bon spyod lha'i me long dang byang chub lam gyi rim pa sogs bka' brten khungs thub rnams kyi rjes su 'brang te rang bzos ma bslad par tshig nyung ngur bsdus te khod spungs dbra ston bskal (skal) bzang bstan rgyal gyis dkyus thog gcig tu bris pa'o//
